import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.util.List;

class UnusedForcedBindings {
    void run(List<String> items) throws Exception {
        for (String _item : items) {
            System.out.println("item");
        }
        for (String ignoredItem : items) { // want "JV011"
            System.out.println("item");
        }
        try (ByteArrayInputStream _resource = new ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[0])) {
            System.out.println("opened");
        }
        try (ByteArrayInputStream unusedResource = new ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[0])) { // want "JV011"
            System.out.println("opened");
        }
    }
}
